run_maskcut_array_jobs: run MaskCut multinode training jobs as a SLURM array using submitit AutoExecutor
submit_trainer_jobs: submit multiple MaskCut Trainer jobs in batch via submitit executor with GPU allocation
parse_args: parse command line arguments for MaskCut training including GPU count, nodes, timeout, and partition
setup_trainer_checkpoint: setup a Trainer checkpoint that requeues a job and resumes from the latest checkpoint file
get_init_file: generate a unique init file URI in the shared folder for distributed training setup
